description: Compare two authenticated inspect_managed_members Evidence records using unique-only tiers: exact declared type, name, and CIL/signature; exact declared type, name, and raw signature (decoded or not); exact declared type, name, and decoded structural method shape; then exact CIL/signature or decoded structural method shape alone, which never takes a member whose own declared type and name remain unpaired on the other side or whose declaring type is unresolved. Names alone are never a matching basis; a member whose signature was not decoded, or whose same-named counterpart's was not, stays unknown rather than added or removed. Metadata tokens remain build-local coordinates bound to each artifact SHA-256 and MVID, and the tuple digest does not itself remap them.
